name: Eric Norris
occupation: Sergeant with the Cheyenne Police Department, supervising the department's Crime Prevention Team; previously a Laramie County Sheriff's Office detention deputy (Wyoming Tribune Eagle, June 2, 2026)
military: United States military, Security Forces (Wyoming Tribune Eagle, June 2, 2026; the article did not name a branch)
background: Eric Norris ran in the 2026 Republican primary for Laramie County sheriff. The Wyoming Tribune Eagle reported in June 2026 that he is a sergeant with the Cheyenne Police Department supervising the department's Crime Prevention Team, that he has been with CPD for 18 years in roles including K-9 handler, firearms instructor, and field training officer, and that he earlier worked as a detention deputy at the Laramie County Sheriff's Office. The paper reported that before civilian law-enforcement work he served in Security Forces in the United States military. He lost the August 18, 2026, Republican primary to incumbent Sheriff Brian Kozak.
